dct_description_sm: The audio of the rhymes is not always identical to the rhymes as transcribed in the article. The reason for this is that the rhymes were gathered from different areas of al-Mahrah, Yemen, and the speaker uses his own dialect from Hawf in eastern al-Mahrah.

This is a set of 25 children's rhymes and riddles recorded by Saeed al-Qumairi from Hawf in the al-Mahrah province of Yemen. They relate to the paper Children's rhymes and nature in Mehri, a Modern South Arabian language. The paper appeared in Journal of Semitic Studies in 2024 authored by Saeed al-Qumairi, Andrea Boom and Janet C.E. Watson.
dct_title_s: Children's rhymes and nature in Mehri, a Modern South Arabian language
